progress.scanning: Searching for a connectable Schneider/WSC mirror cabinet
progress.connecting: Connecting to the Schneider/WSC cabinet over Bluetooth/GATT
progress.waiting_for_button: Bluetooth/GATT is connected. Press the physical pairing/learn button on the light or mirror cabinet NOW. Home Assistant is polling the cabinet every 0.5 seconds and will continue automatically when the cabinet confirms the button press.
progress.syncing: Physical button confirmation received from the cabinet. Reading the current cabinet state and synchronizing date/time exactly as observed in the Schneider app capture.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Schneider Ambient BLE
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up **{name}**? Home Assistant will first establish a Bluetooth/GATT connection. Only after the connection succeeds will Home Assistant tell you to press the physical pairing/learn button.

select_device.title: Select Schneider/WSC device
select_device.description: More than one compatible device was discovered. Select the mirror cabinet you want to add.

no_devices.title: No Schneider/WSC device found
no_devices.description: Home Assistant could not discover a connectable Schneider/WSC device. Make sure the cabinet is powered and the ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy or Bluetooth adapter is online and nearby, then choose **Retry**. Do not press the pairing/learn button yet.

connect_failed.title: Could not connect to the mirror cabinet
connect_failed.description: The WSC device was discovered, but Home Assistant could not establish the Bluetooth/GATT connection. Check the Bluetooth proxy and range, then choose **Retry**. The physical pairing/learn button is only used after the GATT connection succeeds.\n\nTechnical detail: `{error}`

button_timeout.title: Physical button was not confirmed
button_timeout.description: Home Assistant connected successfully but did not observe a fresh C6 transition from a non-authorized value to `0x55` within 60 seconds. A stale `0x55` already present when the connection opens is deliberately not accepted as a new button press. Choose **Retry** and press the physical pairing/learn button only when Home Assistant asks for it.\n\nTechnical detail: `{error}`

sync_failed.title: Post-pairing synchronization failed
sync_failed.description: The cabinet confirmed the physical button press, but Home Assistant could not complete the state reads and date/time synchronization seen in the official app. Choose **Retry** to repeat the full connection and authorization sequence.\n\nTechnical detail: `{error}`

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported by this integration.

create_entry.success: **{name}** was successfully configured with Schneider Ambient BLE.
